biothings.name: prolactin-producing pituitary gland adenoma
biothings.definition: Prolactinoma is a usually benign neoplasm of the pituitary gland that results in hyperprolactinemia. The most common clinical manifestations are amenorrhea and infertility in women; and impotence, decreased libido and infertility in men. [Orphanet:2965]
